item.title: Blogs.Journals.Newsletters.Etc
item.description: Personal blogs (that aren’t AI written) are the window to a nerd’s soul. Also a sort of collection of ‘hacker culture’ lore and wrinkly-brained people ranting. CS Blogs My collection of CS/Math blogs. IN NO PARTICULAR ORDER: diff.blog aggregator Steve Yegge and the old version why I left Google to join Grab Scott Aaronson - the quantum computing guy eigenmorality A Euclidean theater of misery Eric S Raymond the OG hacker; see: jargon file how to become a hacker Paul Graham the ycombinator guy hackers and painters good writing idleword more space stuff dabblers & blowhards a critique of hackers & painters rachelbythebay sysadmin chronicler hope is not a strategy kalzumeus he is like the greatest pm i never had Don’t Call Yourself a Programmer artemis.
